issue_request: FHIR-2856 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request asking whether old Profile.structure.element.definition.type examples that encoded disjunctions as Resource(Patient|Group|Device|Location) were equivalent to repeated type entries, and expecting profile type disjunctions to be represented without ambiguity.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-2856. Jira comments record that ProfileGenerator and validator behavior was adjusted in 2014 and that the issue was fixed before being marked applied. Git history in the same source area shows untagged profile/snapshot work and the Resource()/ResourceReference-to-Reference rename before the Jira applied comment.
additional_context: The current build no longer uses the DSTU1 Profile.structure.element.definition.type model. source/fhir.ini actively includes elementdefinition and structuredefinition; ElementDefinition.type is 0..*; ElementDefinition.type.profile and ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile are repeatable with one-must-apply semantics; generated StructureDefinition XML uses repeated type entries for distinct datatype choices and repeated targetProfile entries for Reference target choices.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current built conformance source already avoids Resource(A|B), has no compact Reference(A|B) in checked-in generated StructureDefinition XML, and documents explicit repeatable type/profile/targetProfile semantics.
